hotel_name: Oyo Tom & Jerry Near Lotus Temple

negative_snippets: Hotel Tom & Jerry is a total disaster. The booking process was a nightmare, taking way too long and filled with confusion. Once I arrived, I was shocked to find the rooms were tiny, smelly cramped, hardly enough space to move around. The location is poorly connected, making it difficult to explore the area. Overall, it felt inferior in quality and below expectations—dull and boring at every turn. Avoid this place.
